- Funny Project - Another Generic Doom Mod

Doom II mod | TBD

  • summary
  • articles
  • files
  • videos
  • images

-FUNNY PROJECT-

-WIP-

Wocht11K

Another generic Doom mod with the original weapons but modified, I know, but I wanted to do something funny.

Quite inspired by mods like Guncaster and Russian Overkill (and also ULTRAKILL), I did some weird things.

The mod consists of a fast-paced arcade game/Only weapons, score exaggerated points, and be the Doomguy at his maximum potential.



The mod is potentially designed to be played with autoaim and freelook disabled (vanilla style), but you can also play it normally.


-Weapons-

WIP some weapons can change their functionality so lol


-CHAINSAW-

It works similarly to vanilla, but it automatically recharges by itself and steals life.


-PISTOL-

Initial weapon, although now you can shoot quickly

(W.I.P Alt Fire)


-93-SHOTGUN-

The Classic, it is one of the most reliable weapons, by clicking quickly you can make a quick bomb and its alternate fire is a back attack, IT SERVES AS A DASH and to maintain combos.



-SSG-Hunter-

Double the power

The most powerful shotgun in the mod, fast, reliable, and with a quick click, you can make single shots.

(W.I.P Alt Fire)


-CHAINGUN-

The chaingun, its greatest advantage is its rate of fire, what's the downside? You're running out of ammo quickly.

(W.I.P Alt Fire)


-ROCKET LAUNCHER-

Rocket jump (if the map allows it)

(W.I.P Alt Fire)


-PLASMA RIFLE-

Powerful rifle weapon that pierces enemies causing massive area damage, however, it overheats.

(W.I.P Alt Fire)


-BIG FUCKING GUN 9000-

Have you used the BFG from Doom (2016) or Eternal?
Well, that

A powerful beam shoots out from the BFG sphere, annihilating everything in its path

(Nuts was a victim of this BFG)

It's the only way to recharge through the player's speed


-And soon more-


Possible questions you might have-
-Can I modify/use the resources of this mod? Do you like the sprites on the weapons?

Yes, as long as you give credit, including to your own people or use the base for another mod.


-Can I play multiplayer?-
Although it is already possible to play multiplayer with the "Funny Project" it may contain quite a few bugs.


-Does the mod work in Zandronum?-

OF COURSE


As I said, the mod is still too much of a WIP and this is the first public beta, it may contain some very funny bugs.


-Without further ado-

[RIP AND TEAR UNTIL YOU FINISH THEM ALL]
